rows.text: A decree of 'Le Président de la République', 'Vu l'article 8 de la Constitution', published in JORF n°0143 of 20 June 2017 (NOR HRUX1718116D), decrees 'M. Edouard Philippe est nommé Premier ministre' and closes 'Fait le 19 juin 2017.', signed 'Emmanuel Macron'.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-38 only (Premier ministre; the Prime Ministers appointed from 31 March 2014 to the 7 September 2026 cutoff, the next batch after CLAUDE-C01-37). The Prime Minister's letter presenting the Government's resignation, the decree ending the Government's functions, the decree appointing a Prime Minister and a decree the Prime Minister signs stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. The Président de la République, ministers, party offices and continued handling of current affairs are excluded.
